Food Safety Officials Diverted from Duties Amidst Checks

Food safety enforcement efforts have been impacted as officials were reportedly diverted to perform duties related to Chief Minister Satheesan's VIP engagements. The Kolkata Municipal Corporation (KMC) has intensified food safety checks across the city, collecting samples for laboratory testing. This comes amidst concerns about the effectiveness of food safety enforcement.
